summary: Phase 4 (Smart Cart & Checkout) end-to-end verified. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed on /api/delivery/slots, /api/addresses CRUD + default toggle, /api/orders with new Phase-4 fields (address_id, delivery_slot_id, delivery_slot_label, handling_fee), plus regressions (deals, products, OTP, geo/reverse-pin). Frontend: OTP login works, Profile now surfaces 'Saved Addresses', /addresses form creates first address as auto-default with DEFAULT badge + Edit/Delete/Set-default actions, and 'Add new address' dashed CTA. Cart proceed-checkout-btn routes to /checkout (for logged-in user; guests hit /otp per code). /checkout renders 'Deliver to' + 'Change/Add new' link, 4 delivery slot cards (Express highlighted with orange FASTEST pill + 3 Tomorrow slots), Payment method with Cash on Delivery pre-selected AND 'UPI / Cards / Wallets · coming soon' info line, transparent order summary (Item total ₹41 + Delivery · express ₹49 + Handling & packing ₹9 = Total ₹99 in bold blue), and sticky footer Total pill + Place order button. Place-order button correctly disabled when no address selected. Razorpay was NOT tested (Phase 5 deferred per user).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — likely from src/theme.ts shadow presets applied via StyleSheet. Not blocking, but worth migrating for RN Web 0.19+.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a component (possibly a Modal or Animated overlay). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate theme.shadow.* → boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: replace `pointerEvents` prop usages with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` for RN Web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1500 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, addresses, orders, deals, subscriptions) for maintainability before adding Razorpay.
POST /addresses uses body.is_default OR count==0; correctly clears others when default=true. LGTM.
OrderIn already accepts payment_method literal 'rzp' — placeholder for Phase 5; harmless for now since no /payments/rzp routes exist.
/api/delivery/slots uses `(now.hour + 5) % 24` for IST — off by 30 minutes vs true IST (+5:30). Fine for Phase 4 messaging but flag for later polish.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh OTP-based user (random 10-digit mobile) and their own addresses; nothing persisted across runs. No admin data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are located at /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_cart_checkout.py. Cart is in-memory (not persisted), so end-to-end frontend tests must chain: login → add product → cart pincode check → proceed → checkout in a SINGLE session. The mobile OTP user won't have a seeded address, so the checkout Place-order button will be disabled (this is expected). For a fully-populated flow, create an address via UI first, then add a cart item.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Phase 4 backend and frontend both verified end-to-end.
